interpretation: The promoted causal branch kernels require both graphs to declare inspector='hf-causal-decoder' and position_policy='rope'. A chimera-omni graph declares neither, so the planner refuses this crossing rather than emitting a transaction no registered operator could execute. That refusal is the correct behavior and it is why the numeric fold below is a driver-local closed-form transaction built from hf_closed_form_fit rather than a planned action.
